prompts.title: Pop Art Portrait of a Man with Headphones
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed comic-book / graphic-novel style digital illustration of a confident handsome man wearing large black over-ear headphones. He has neatly styled hair, blue eyes, strong eyebrows, defined facial features, and a calm, serious expression while looking directly at the camera.
He is dressed in a black leather jacket with realistic glossy folds and texture, layered over a plain black crew-neck T-shirt, with a thick silver Cuban-link chain necklace around his neck. Frame him as a centered chest-up portrait, with the head and shoulders occupying most of the composition.
Use a bold bright yellow background with an energetic street-art / comic aesthetic. Add scattered black ink splashes, paint droplets, halftone dots, geometric abstract shapes, diagonal graphic accents, and subtle distressed texture around the subject. Use thin black comic outlines, sharp cel-shading, cross-hatching, stippling, and carefully detailed rendered skin and hair details.
Lighting should be dramatic but clean, with strong highlights on the face, hair, headphones, jacket, and necklace. Maintain a sophisticated modern graphic novel / premium editorial illustration appearance, combining realistic facial proportions with stylized comic rendering.
Composition: symmetrical, straight-on camera angle, centered face, tight chest-up framing, strong visual hierarchy, crisp edges, high contrast.
Color palette: vibrant yellow background, black and charcoal clothing, warm peach skin tones, cool blue eyes, metallic silver necklace.
Style: ultra-detailed comic book illustration, premium digital art, dynamic ink work, bold outlines, realistic anatomy, cel shading, halftone texture, cinematic lighting, sharp details, 8K quality.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: The War Within
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image strictly as the identity reference for the subject.
Preserve the subject’s exact facial identity, bone structure, proportions, skin tone, hairline, beard pattern, eye shape, and overall likeness.

Do not beautify, stylize, or modify the person’s identity.
Composition
Create a high-resolution surreal double-exposure portrait.
The subject appears in a strict 90-degree side profile facing right.
The pose must be true profile, meaning:

only the right side of the face is visible
no part of the left cheek, left shoulder, or left body is visible
the nose, lips, beard, and forehead form a clean profile silhouette
Frame the subject from chest up.
Position the subject slightly left of center, leaving negative space in front of the face.
Aspect ratio 4:5 or 2:3 vertical.
Background should be a clean, soft off-white.
Appearance
Hair and beard must match the reference image naturally.
The beard should show fine detail and realistic texture.
Expression is calm, serious, and contemplative, with the eye looking forward.
Clothing
The subject wears:

a black blazer
a black turtleneck
The blazer fabric should appear smooth, structured, and slightly glossy, with subtle reflections from studio lighting.
The shoulder line should look sharp and tailored, giving a modern minimalist look.
Double Exposure Effect
The upper back portion of the subject’s head and hair transforms seamlessly into a cinematic internal scene.
Inside the silhouette appears a deep perspective ruined city street.

Internal Scene
A single man in a suit walks away from the viewer toward the horizon.
He is seen from behind, centered in the street.
The street is surrounded by damaged multi-story buildings.
Debris and rubble scatter across the ground.
Small fires burn along the sides of the street, producing orange glowing flames.
Horizon
At the end of the street is a blinding golden light source, resembling a powerful sunset or distant explosion.
Lighting
External lighting
Soft studio lighting from the front-right, highlighting:

nose bridge
cheekbone
beard texture
Internal lighting
The sunset inside the head creates a warm rim glow around the hair and neck.
Color Palette
Exterior portrait:
cool neutral tones

soft off-white background

natural skin tones
Internal scene:
warm cinematic tones

orange flames

golden sunlight

deep shadows
Rendering Quality
photorealistic

ultra detailed

cinematic lighting

high dynamic range

shallow depth of field

sharp textures

prompts.title: Beyond the Screen
prompts.prompt:
**"A 4K photorealistic surreal advertising composite, 4:5 aspect ratio. Wide-angle perspective (24mm feel).
THE SCENE:** A perfectly centered, front-facing iPhone 16 Pro stands on a smooth, vibrant orange radial gradient studio background with a subtle grounding drop shadow.
THE BREAKOUT ACTION: Based strictly on the reference image's identity, a confident man wearing blue aviator sunglasses, a gray hoodie, and blue jeans is physically emerging from the screen. His head, right shoulder, and a strongly foreshortened right hand extend powerfully toward the viewer, breaking the phone's frame. His body remains inside the screen against a heavily blurred cinematic night city bokeh.
CRITICAL UI LAYERING: Inside the screen, a realistic green iOS message notification banner reading "Hello – Prompt Plum" is positioned across his torso. Crucially, this banner appears behind his emerging right hand but in front of his chest.
LIGHTING: High-end professional studio lighting from the front-left, creating realistic highlights and shadows on the emerging subject and the phone."
